scope: native source snapshot of the pinned LaBRADOR reference and SIMDe revisions, with Quilibrium adapters and tools
recipe: ARM64 portability build of the pinned LaBRADOR and SIMDe revisions (clang, assertions enabled)
portability_note: Projection buffer uses C11 _Alignas, equivalent to the 64-byte alignas spelling and accepted by Ubuntu 22.04 clang without stdalign.h.
resource_trace: Opt-in QUIL_NATIVE_RESOURCE_TRACE=1 stage names and process peak RSS; diagnostics only, proof relations/parameters unchanged.
cached_offsets: Adapter retains immutable witness-vector prefix offsets once per context; generic frontend wrappers remain available. Regression compares native coefficients, offsets and statement transcript.
coefficient_pool: Original input statements share exact matching public zero, signed unit monomial and signed all-one coefficient vectors within each context. Pool owns storage until statement destruction; transformed statements retain native deep copies.
diagnostic_policy: No unconditional mask-rejection retry logging. DEBUG dumps, NDEBUG assertion removal, and disabled native randomness/masking/rejection configurations are rejected; optional coarse resource tracing remains available.
private_prg: LNP uses a fresh 32-byte private seed and AES-256 streams for Gaussian masks, uniform masks, uniform bytes and rejection draws. Shared sampler kernels preserve public AES-128 interfaces. Does not revise public transcript/challenge security parameters.
